name: core.openwop.connections.linkedin-ads
description: LinkedIn Ads connection pack — OAuth2 provider for the LinkedIn Marketing API. Reach is `openapi`: the manifest declares the global LinkedIn OAuth hosts and points at the Marketing API reference, consumed by the core.openwop.http nodes. Carries NO secret; the operator supplies the client id/secret host-side. One of the three ad platforms Campaign Studio syncs (Google / Meta / LinkedIn Ads).
